intent: The user asks for a reminder to drink water every minute. The bot should remind on its own with no input while the clock runs, stop when asked, and stay quiet afterwards.

steps.say: Please remind me to drink water every minute.
Thanks, you can stop the water reminders now.

criteria.learning: The bot agrees to remind and then does so without being asked again.
criteria.schedule: Water reminders arrive about once a minute with no input.
criteria.stopping: Asked to stop, the bot stops and no more reminders come.
